entity.summary: Self-custody wallet lineage from Coinbase now branded Base App, continuing the former Coinbase Wallet mobile experience while preserving user-controlled wallet credentials and supported-network assets.
entity.notes: Base App is the continuing Coinbase Wallet lineage, not a separate successor entity. Base announced the rebrand in July 2025, and Coinbase closed the classic wallet experience on 2026-08-15 while preserving recovery phrases, supported-network assets and addresses. WLR intentionally retains the historical slug coinbase-wallet so existing human, native-machine, Series and global-record URLs remain stable. Coinbase continues to distribute a separately branded Coinbase Wallet browser extension; that extension is not silently collapsed into the existing mobile-product record.

products.summary: Self-custody iOS and Android mobile wallet formerly branded Coinbase Wallet Mobile and now distributed as Base App, with continuity of the installed wallet and user-controlled credentials.
products.notes: Existing Coinbase Wallet mobile users continue in Base App without downloading a separate successor app. Coinbase states that the classic experience closed on 2026-08-15 but the recovery phrase, supported-network assets and addresses remain continuous. WLR intentionally retains the historical product slug coinbase-wallet-mobile for stable public and machine URLs.

events.title: Coinbase Wallet announced transition to Base App
events.description: At Base's A New Day One event, Base announced that Coinbase Wallet was becoming the Base App, describing Base App as the next evolution of Coinbase Wallet and beginning a beta rollout for the renamed and expanded application.
events.notes: This is a continuity/rebrand event, not the launch of a separate successor wallet. Base first-party material says Base App is formerly Coinbase Wallet and that Coinbase Wallet is now Base App. The exact 2025-07-16 announcement boundary is corroborated by contemporaneous dated reporting from the event. Existing WLR IDs and slugs remain stable.

events.title: Classic Coinbase Wallet experience closed
events.description: Coinbase closed the classic Coinbase Wallet experience on August 15, 2026 and replaced it with the updated Base App experience while preserving the user's recovery phrase, supported-network assets and wallet addresses.
events.notes: This is a shutdown of the legacy/classic experience, not a shutdown of the continuing wallet product. Coinbase says there is nothing to transfer or sign merely to continue in the updated wallet. Some legacy networks are not supported in Base App and may require importing the same recovery phrase into another compatible wallet.

evidence.title: Coinbase Wallet | Safety & Security
evidence.notes: Current Coinbase page explicitly calls Coinbase Wallet a self-custody Web3 wallet and says users control the private keys.

evidence.title: Web3 wallet, Coinbase.com & Coinbase Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party help explicitly distinguishes self-custodied Coinbase Wallet from Coinbase.com custody and the separate split-key Web3 wallet.

evidence.title: Base's Next Chapter: Everything We Announced At A New Day One
evidence.notes: First-party Base announcement explicitly calls Base App formerly Coinbase Wallet, describes it as the next evolution of Coinbase Wallet, and says Coinbase Wallet is now Base App. Exact event-day corroboration is stored separately rather than inventing missing page publication metadata.

evidence.title: Coinbase unveils Base App, rebrands wallet as all-in-one social and trading platform
evidence.notes: Contemporaneous dated report from the A New Day One event used only to anchor the exact 2025-07-16 announcement boundary. The continuity/rebrand claim itself is backed by Base first-party material.

evidence.title: Classic wallet closing
evidence.notes: Coinbase Help gives the exact 2026-08-15 closure date and states that the updated wallet preserves recovery phrase, supported-network assets and addresses with nothing to transfer merely to continue.

evidence.title: Download Base App
evidence.notes: Current Coinbase distribution page says Coinbase Wallet is now Base App, existing users do not need a new app, and Base App is distributed on iOS and Android. It separately exposes the Coinbase Wallet browser extension, which is outside wlr_prod_000125's mobile boundary.
